The '''Vapor Room''' was a drinking establishment in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].

==Description==
This industrial cantina was located in an unused portion of a [[Bespin construction platform]], filled with tanks and pipes, and was known to serve a wide variety of illegal drinks.

==History==
The Vapor Room was a "watering hole" for [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] residing in Cloud City, giving them a break from the regular construction work on the larger settlement.

The crew of ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'' located [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] there.
